title: Laurentian bank selects Kyndryl to modernize mission-critical technology
summary: Expanded collaboration combines AI-powered operations, managed services and consulting expertise to support bank’s transformation
body_markdown:
**MONTREAL, Canada, November 17, 2026** —[Kyndryl](https://www.kyndryl.com/us/en) (NYSE: KD), a leading provider of mission-critical enterprise technology services, today announced an expanded collaboration with[Laurentian Bank](https://www.laurentianbank.ca/en) to help modernize and manage the bank’s IT operations as it advances a significant business transformation to its specialty commercial bank model. Under the agreement, Kyndryl will provide managed services,[consulting expertise](https://www.kyndryl.com/us/en/consulting) and AI-powered operational capabilities to help Laurentian Bank simplify and modernize its technology environment while maintaining the resilience, security and performance required to support evolving commercial businesses and regulatory demands.


Through[Kyndryl Bridge](https://www.kyndryl.com/us/en/services/platform) , the company’s AI-powered, open integration digital business platform, Laurentian Bank will gain visibility across its technology environment, supported by actionable insights and automation. By providing a unified view of critical systems and operations, Kyndryl Bridge will proactively identify issues, accelerate decision-making and improve operational oversight. These capabilities can help reduce operational and cyber risk while maintaining the reliability and performance of critical[banking services](https://www.kyndryl.com/us/en/industries/banking-and-financial-markets) .


"The organizations best positioned for the future are those that can continuously adapt while maintaining the stability their business depends on,” said Brian Medeiros, President, Kyndryl Canada. “For Laurentian Bank, that means having the confidence to advance its transformation, while continuing to deliver the trusted banking experience its customers expect. We’re proud to continue supporting the bank on that journey.”


The collaboration builds on a longstanding relationship between Kyndryl and Laurentian Bank, including several successful modernization initiatives over the years. As Laurentian Bank continues its business transformation, Kyndryl will support the bank to pursue future innovation while maintaining the agility needed to respond to evolving business priorities.


**About Laurentian Bank** Founded in Montreal in 1846, Laurentian Bank is committed to serving its customers and fostering deep relationships with specialized groups. Laurentian Bank runs operations across Canada – primarily in Québec and Ontario – as well as in the United States and competes where it sees market opportunity and has an edge, while harnessing the power of partnerships and collaboration. For more information, visit[www.laurentianbank.ca](https://www.laurentianbank.ca/en) .


**About Kyndryl** Kyndryl (NYSE: KD) is a leading provider of mission-critical enterprise technology services, offering advisory, implementation and managed service capabilities to thousands of customers in more than 60 countries. As the world’s largest IT infrastructure services provider, the company designs, builds, manages and modernizes the complex information systems that the world depends on every day. For more information, visit[www.kyndryl.com](https://www.kyndryl.com/us/en) .
